prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change



Spec change: https://github.com/XRPLF/XRPL-Standards/pull/562
We're getting rid of the clear flags for dynamic MPTs. Flags that are marked mutable at issuance can still be turned on by the issuer, but they will become immutable immediately after they are set.

### Context of Change

- TxFlags.h: Remove clear mutable flags
- MPTokenIssuanceSet.cpp: Remove clear mutable flags related logic
- Tests:
1.  Affect tests related to dynamic mpt in MPToken_test.cpp
2. Affect existing tests relying on the clear flags.

**The following tests are removed.**
Before: create with mpt transferrable and then `ClearCanTransfer` and then test deposit/withdraw
After: case removed because creation fails when mpt non-transferrable.

`Vault_test`:
- testcase("MPT non-transferable: block deposit, allow withdraw")
- testcase("MPT non-transferable: pre-fixCleanup3_2_0 withdraw blocked")
- testcase("MPT non-transferable: vault shares inherit restriction")
- testcase("MPT non-transferable: pre-fixCleanup3_2_0 share transfer succeeds")

`Loan_test`:
- testcase("CoverDeposit blocked, CoverWithdraw allowed when CanTransfer cleared")
- testcase("Lending: CanTrade disabled has no impact")

`AMMMPT_test`:
- testcase("Invalid AMMWithdraw") // MPTCanTransfer is not set and the account is not the issuer of MPT


**The following tests are modified.**
Before: mpt initialized with CanTransfer/CanTrade, test success first but later cleared to test failure.
After: mpt initialized without CanTransfer/CanTrade, test failure first, and then enabled and test success.

`Vault_test`:
- testcase("MPT CanTrade governance: share inherits underlying on DEX and AMM");

`Loan_test`:
- testcase("Lending: CanTrade cleared has no impact") ->  testcase("Lending: CanTrade disabled has no impact")

`MPToken_test`:
- testOfferCrossing
- testCrossAssetPayment
- testCheckCash
- testAMMClawback
- testBasicAMM
- testTradeAndTransfer



### API Impact



- [ ] Public API: New feature (new methods and/or new fields)
- [ ] Public API: Breaking change (in general, breaking changes should only impact the next api_version)
- [x] `libxrpl` change (any change that may affect `libxrpl` or dependents of `libxrpl`)
- [ ] Peer protocol change (must be backward compatible or bump the peer protocol version)
prs.head: yinyiqian1:dynamic_mpt_new

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body:
## Pull request overview This PR updates Dynamic MPT (XLS-94) behavior to remove “clear” mutable flags, making MPT capability flags one-way (only enableable) and adjusting transactor logic and tests accordingly. **Changes:** - Removes MPTokenIssuanceSet “clear” mutable flags and updates the enable-only flag mapping/validation. - Renames mutability capability flags from `CanMutate*` to `CanEnable*` and updates protocol flag definitions. - Refactors/updates multiple unit tests to align with enable-only semantics (including removing scenarios that relied on clearing flags). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | src/test/jtx/impl/mpt.cpp | Refactors test helper mutable-flag application to enable-only via a mapping table. | | src/test/app/Vault_test.cpp | Updates vault/MPT governance tests to reflect enable-only CanTrade/CanTransfer behavior; removes tests relying on clearing. | | src/test/app/MPToken_test.cpp | Updates Dynamic MPT tests to remove clearing flows and validate enable-only semantics across DEX/AMM/check/payment paths. | | src/test/app/Loan_test.cpp | Removes/updates lending tests that depended on clearing CanTransfer/CanTrade; adds enable-only coverage for CanTrade. | | src/test/app/AMMMPT_test.cpp | Updates AMM/MPT tests for non-transferable behavior without clear flags (withdrawal path for existing LP holders). | | src/libxrpl/tx/transactors/token/MPTokenIssuanceSet.cpp | Removes clear-flag handling and enforces enable-only mutation rules in preflight/preclaim/apply. | | include/xrpl/protocol/TxFlags.h | Removes clear mutable flag constants; renames create-time mutability flags to `CanEnable*`; updates masks/bit assignments. | | include/xrpl/protocol/LedgerFormats.h | Renames ledger mutability flags to `lsmfMPTCanEnable*` to match enable-only semantics. |

## Pull Request Overview This PR implements the DynamicMPT amendment (XLS-94d) that allows issuers to mutate Multi-Purpose Token (MPT) properties after creation. The amendment enables modification of metadata, transfer fees, and specific flags that control token behavior. issues.title: MPTokenIssuanceSet delegates can bypass permission checks for DynamicMPT mutation operations
issues.author: RomThpt
issues.body:
## Summary

`MPTokenIssuanceSet::checkPermission()` only validates granular delegate permissions for `tfMPTLock` and `tfMPTUnlock` flags. When `featureDynamicMPT` is enabled, the transaction can also carry mutation fields (`sfMutableFlags`, `sfMPTokenMetadata`, `sfTransferFee`, `sfDomainID`), but these are not checked in the granular permission path. A delegate with *any* permission can submit a mutation-only transaction (no Lock/Unlock flags) and it will fall through to `return tesSUCCESS`, bypassing authorization.

## Current Behavior

In `checkPermission()`, after `checkTxPermission()` fails (delegate lacks full transaction-level permission), the function loads granular permissions and checks only for Lock/Unlock. If neither flag is set, the function unconditionally returns `tesSUCCESS`:

```cpp
if (tx.isFlag(tfMPTLock) && !granularPermissions.contains(MPTokenIssuanceLock))
    return terNO_DELEGATE_PERMISSION;

if (tx.isFlag(tfMPTUnlock) && !granularPermissions.contains(MPTokenIssuanceUnlock))
    return terNO_DELEGATE_PERMISSION;

return tesSUCCESS;  // No check for mutation fields
```

A delegate holding only `MPTokenIssuanceLock` (or any other unrelated granular permission) can submit a transaction with `sfMutableFlags`, `sfMPTokenMetadata`, `sfTransferFee`, or `sfDomainID` set and no Lock/Unlock flags. Both Lock/Unlock checks pass (they are `if ... &&` guards that skip when the flag is absent), and the function returns `tesSUCCESS`.

## Expected Behavior

A delegate without full transaction-level permission (`ttMPTOKEN_ISSUANCE_SET`) should not be able to perform mutation operations. Since no granular permission type exists for DynamicMPT mutations yet, any delegate attempting a mutation-only transaction should receive `terNO_DELEGATE_PERMISSION`.

## Impact

This is a privilege escalation: any delegate with any granular `MPTokenIssuanceSet` permission can mutate MPT issuance properties (flags, metadata, transfer fees, domain) without authorization from the issuer.

**Mitigating factor:** `featureDynamicMPT` is currently set to `Supported::No` and is not enabled on mainnet, so this is not exploitable in production today.

## Suggested Fix

Before the final `return tesSUCCESS` in `checkPermission()`, add a guard that rejects the transaction if any mutation field is present:

```cpp
if (tx.isFieldPresent(sfMutableFlags) || tx.isFieldPresent(sfMPTokenMetadata) ||
    tx[~sfTransferFee] || tx.isFieldPresent(sfDomainID))
    return terNO_DELEGATE_PERMISSION;
```

This preserves the existing behavior for Lock/Unlock and blocks mutation operations for delegates until a dedicated granular permission type is introduced.
